name: State-price convex hull
assumptions: Correct payoff semantics and state support
computational_requirements: Explicit small-state LP or optimisation oracle
failure_mode: Semantic misspecification

name: Sharp LP target bounds
core_equation: L=min c^T pi; U=max c^T pi subject to hard constraints
failure_mode: State explosion or false hard edges

name: LP dual replication certificate
assumptions: Strong duality and correctly specified linear constraints
failure_mode: Poor interpretability if constraints are badly scaled; no economic execution implied without tradability

name: Identified-set information value
failure_mode: Can measure structural redundancy but not predictive alpha

name: Weighted QP coherent projection
failure_mode: Point estimate can hide non-identification

name: Bernoulli-KL / Bregman projection
core_equation: argmin_{p in C} sum w_i D_Ber(p_i||p_hat_i)
failure_mode: Boundary instability; orientation of KL matters

name: Probabilistic forecast reconciliation
core_equation: reconcile base predictive distribution to linear coherent constraints
assumptions: Known constraint structure; base forecast error model
failure_mode: Shared information/endogeneity can invalidate naive covariance weights

name: KL I-projection / MaxEnt
computational_requirements: Convex optimisation; GIS/IPF or dual methods
failure_mode: Uniform reference is still an assumption; large state space

name: Junction-tree exact inference
computational_requirements: Exponential in treewidth not number of races
failure_mode: Large dense cliques

name: Local-polytope outer relaxation
core_equation: M exact subset of L local; optimise target over L
failure_mode: Bounds may be wide; point estimates from relaxation are not exact

name: Frank-Wolfe + election-state MILP oracle
core_equation: linear oracle argmin_omega g^T Y(omega) inside Bregman projection
failure_mode: Worst-case hardness; oracle modelling burden

name: Count tail-sum identity
assumptions: Common count semantics and complete threshold ladder
failure_mode: Incomplete/coarse thresholds give bounds not exact mean

name: Count factorial moments
failure_mode: Aggregates dependence but does not localise it

name: Ecological-inference aggregate-to-micro bounds
core_equation: optimise micro marginals/joints over aggregate constraints
assumptions: Correct aggregation map; optional shape restrictions labelled
failure_mode: Fundamental non-identification can remain wide

name: Poisson-binomial exact count engine
failure_mode: Invalid if residual dependence remains

name: Low-dimensional probit/logit election factor
failure_mode: Factor misspecification; endogeneity; weak identification

name: Generic Gaussian copula
core_equation: latent Gaussian dependence with Bernoulli thresholds
assumptions: Valid global correlation matrix; copula correctness
failure_mode: Pairwise fits may be globally inconsistent and overfit

name: Dynamic nonlinear filter
assumptions: Static structural model valid; past-only parameters
failure_mode: Precisely tracks a wrong model; double counting

name: Common-information-aware fusion
core_equation: carry source ancestry; conservative fusion when cross-correlation unknown
assumptions: Estimator uncertainty and source ancestry represented
failure_mode: Gaussian CI not directly probability-native

name: Hasbrouck information share / VECM
core_equation: cointegrated prices share common efficient price
failure_mode: Invalid for nonlinear structurally linked claims

name: ETF creation/redemption arbitrage
core_equation: ETF price vs convertible basket NAV
failure_mode: Institutional mechanism absent in event networks
recommended_use: Do not call R3 ETF arbitrage
